comment: Which game events make a sound. The sounds themselves come from D2's tables at extraction: skills.txt stsound for every skill's cast (raising a summon included), missiles.txt TravelSound and HitSound for every missile in sprites.json skillArt, monstats.txt MonSound then monsounds.txt DeathSound for deaths (summons too), and levels.txt SoundEnv then soundenviron.txt for the level's song and day ambience.
